verse.verse_1: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of the daybreak,
verse.verse_2: "From the evil of what He has created;
verse.verse_3: "And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away).
verse.verse_4: "And from the evil of the witchcrafts when they blow in the knots,
verse.verse_5: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."
